title: Starboy
course: Level 3, Extended Diploma in Art, Design and Communication
body: The inspiration comes from the footballer Bukayo Saka, who is the number 7 for Arsenal Football Club and England. Bukayo has had such inspiration and influence within the footballing world and is someone I idolise for the mentality and passion he possesses. This piece is all about cultural pride and power; the raw and urban graffiti, along with the celebration, captures a moment of pure joy and power.

title: Peep Show
course: Level 3, Extended Diploma in Art, Design and Communication
body: Digital art visually inspired by kitschy 50s and 60s showgirls, mixed with classic fetish imagery, representing materials like latex to show that there’s always something going on underneath the surface.
destination: Foundation Diploma in Art and Design

title: Le Velours Rouge!
course: Level 3, Extended Diploma in Art, Design and Communication
materials: Burgundy velvet, burgundy appliques, fringing, beads, feathers, feather boa, rigilene boning, eyelets, burgundy ribbon
body: This piece is a showgirl costume inspired by the Moulin Rouge. I wanted to express the liberation of women by creating a striking corset influenced by Catherine Zuber.

title: You win or you die
course: Level 3, Extended Diploma in Art, Design and Communication
body: An oil painting of a fallen knight on a past battlefield; a king stands over him victorious and unharmed by the battle.
destination: Manchester Metropolitan University — Fine Art Degree

title: Rock 'n' Roll Revival
course: UAL Level 3 Extended Diploma in Creative Practice, Art, Design and Communication
materials: Cotton fabric, recycled garments, leather fabric and silk
body: My design is about a 50s-inspired outfit for a classic 1950s film, including the themes of one of my favourite films I have grown up with, Grease, the 50s icons Marilyn Monroe and Audrey Hepburn, and the influence of the 50s Cadillac Coupe Deville.

title: The Return of Couture
course: UAL Level 3 Extended Diploma in Creative Practice, Art, Design and Communication
body: My work is inspired by 1950s haute couture, and how designers like Christian Dior revolutionised the industry and changed history to this day.

title: Legacy
course: UAL Level 3 Extended Diploma in Creative Practice, Art, Design and Communication
materials: Spray paints, acrylic paints and oil paints
body: This piece is about the rise of black movements in the 70s, where the culture of hip hop, black music, black sportsmen and significant people shaped the world and highlighted the importance of racial equality. The focus is on the footballer Pelé, who was significant in this era and is considered to be one of the most famous black people of all time.

title: Historical Costume
course: UAL Level 3 Extended Diploma in Creative Practice, Art, Design and Communication
body: My piece is inspired by the dresses that were made and designed for the Netflix series Bridgerton. I wanted to design a dress inspired by the series for a stage or theatre production.

title: Interior Design
course: UAL Level 3 Extended Diploma in Creative Practice, Art, Design and Communication
materials: Recycled furniture, paint, clay, fabric, wallpaper and digital software
body: My work for this project was inspired by my love for interior design throughout the ages. I specifically focused on creating a contemporary outcome influenced by the beauty of the Edwardian era and all that it stood for.

title: Nouveau
course: UAL Level 3 Extended Diploma in Creative Practice, Art, Design and Communication
materials: Oil paint on primed MDF board
body: This piece is based on the 1910s style Art Nouveau.

title: Slim Shady
course: UAL Level 3 Extended Diploma in Creative Practice, Art, Design and Communication
body: A celebration of music from the Noughties.

title: Egyptian Graffitti
course: Extended Diploma in Creative Practice, Art Design and Communication — Level 3 Year 1
body: The work explores the links between modern-day graffiti and the Egyptians’ early use of graphics.

title: Yesterday
course: Extended Diploma in Creative Practice, Art Design and Communication — Level 3 Year 1
body: A memory-based work inspired by the lyrics of The Beatles and the culture of the 60s.
